title: Gap-free odd-Matsubara resolvent telescoping budget
question: Can the exact resolvent difference identity give a summable, gap-free budget for the resolvent part of the positive Matsubara kernel while isolating the absolute-value square-root term as a separate locality obligation?
method: Build the local V=2 cutoff-2 bond commutator Liouvillian and perturb it with a noncommuting local momentum term.
For both beta values and all 64 odd frequencies, compute the two positive resolvents and check R_n(B)-R_n(A)=R_n(B) beta^2 (A^2-B^2) R_n(A).
Check denominator positivity, the 1/omega_n^2 operator ceiling, the Frobenius budget beta^2 ||A^2-B^2||_F/omega_n^4, and the accumulated 64-layer budget.

Decompose the positive kernel difference into the absolute-value square-root term plus the resolvent term, retain the first as explicit debt, reconstruct with a non-importing independent lane, and compile Lean R377.
finding: The primary and independent lanes each pass 1056/1056 assertions and agree exactly at stored precision.  The integrated verifier passes 122/122 with Lean R377 PASS.  The largest identity residual is 6.11350532313155e-17, the largest accumulated budget ratio is 0.9895313426497929, and the maximum recorded square-root debt is 0.1239852906116096.
decision_reason: The exact resolvent algebra isolates a finite, gap-free and summable resolvent contribution and makes the remaining absolute-value/eigenvector term explicit.  It is a local finite interface only, so no uniform locality or common-alpha promotion is justified.

adversarial_review.check: The matrix resolvent identity could have the wrong sign or product order.
The bound could hide an inverse minimum gap.
A mode denominator could lose positivity.
The finite resolvent budget might fail after summation.
A scalar identity could be mistaken for the matrix identity.
The absolute-value term could be silently absorbed.
The small fixture could hide growth.
The local fixture might not equal the weighted Q3 shell.
The independent lane could import the primary implementation.
The finite interface could silently close Q3 or Pre-A.

next_action: Prove a source-, volume- and cutoff-uniform energy-constrained estimate for the isolated square-root/local-commutator term, then sum the resolvent layers on the common polynomial core.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite resolvent-algebra interface only.  It does not prove operator-norm locality, common core, common alpha, KMS/GNS dynamics, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A.
no_overclaim: R-377 isolates a finite resolvent budget and a nonzero square-root debt; it does not prove the general theorem or any QFT closure.
